track: General empirical AI/ML; focused discovery, not systematic review

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Vision: few-normal-image calibration under lighting shift and contaminated supports
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: Incoming conditions distort normal features; contaminated calibration can suppress defects
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Broad claim rejected as occupied. [SPARC](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.18585v1); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.48550/arxiv.2608.18585) already studies this. Redesigned as CV1-R, still a reserve

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Vision: lab-to-field or unseen-crop plant disease recognition
screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: PlantVillage and field/crop datasets are leads; compact transfer model
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Excluded: no verified shared label ontology, dataset pairing or distinct new gap; [2026 unseen-crop work](https://doi.org/10.3390/electronics15081553); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.3390/electronics15081553) is a close lead requiring careful comparison

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Vision: lower-memory few-shot industrial anomaly detection
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: Patch memories consume resources when reference data grows
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Current formulation rejected: memory/few-shot optimisation alone is already well developed; [AnomalyDINO](https://arxiv.org/html/2405.14529v1); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.1109/wacv61041.2025.00136) and [PatchCore optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.10792); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.48550/arxiv.2307.10792) are immediate neighbours

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Text: restore out-of-scope rejection after few-shot intent adaptation
screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: CLINC/BANKING-style benchmarks; encoder plus distance scoring
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: Adaptation changes confidence and known/unknown separation
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Rejected as the primary claim: [October 2026 personalization paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.20652v1); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.48550/arxiv.2610.20652) already investigates this

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Text: compact answerability/abstention for document QA
screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: Existing QA/evidence-labelled datasets are leads; extractive encoder/answerability head
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: Retrieved text may be relevant but insufficient to answer
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Excluded: generic abstention is occupied; dataset licence, ground truth and a distinctive claim were not verified. [Attribute or Abstain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.07799); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.48550/arxiv.2407.07799) is an immediate lead

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Text: label-efficient open-world class discovery and rejection
screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: [BOLT](https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.667/); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.667) is a benchmark lead; compact classifier
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Excluded: a broad task, not a precise methodological gap; three connected bounded investigations were not established

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Audio: source/target score calibration for first-shot machine monitoring
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: One threshold handles unequal source/target score distributions poorly
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Rejected as generic novelty: [local-density normalisation](https://arxiv.org/html/2509.10951v1); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.1109/taslpro.2025.3629236) and [2026 calibration/model-selection work](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.04526v1); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.48550/arxiv.2607.04526) are too close

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Audio: compact device-robust acoustic scene classifier
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Generic formulation rejected; compact device robustness is the established challenge. AU2-R adds a research question about confidence ordering, but its novelty rating is still too weak

screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: RADAR / AT-ADD are dataset leads; pretrained audio encoder with trained head
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Excluded: a broad, active benchmark problem without a specific contribution; dataset access/licence and compute were not checked

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Time series: label-free event alarms under drift
screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: ESA anomaly telemetry; simple detector and temporal model
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: Threshold selection, alarm burden and nominal regime changes
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Excluded in current form: novelty unresolved and full official pipeline conflicts with resource assumptions; a reduced study would need fresh scope/evidence

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Time series: uncertainty-aware load forecasts with missing history
screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: UCI electricity; quantile learner and conformal intervals
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: Missing histories invalidate naive uncertainty handling
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Broad novelty claim rejected; existing missing-data and conformal work is close. Revised as TS2-R, with the feedback schedule distinction still unverified

screened_candidates.Modality and initial idea: Time series: compare/fine-tune foundation models for household demand
screened_candidates.Existing data/baseline lead: UCI electricity; small forecasting model and pretrained-model leads
screened_candidates.Failure to investigate: Published rankings may not transfer to household settings
screened_candidates.Outcome and evidence: Current formulation rejected: model comparison alone lacks a defined contribution; [existing household benchmark](https://doi.org/10.1109/access.2025.3648056); [Zotero](https://literature.researchfasttrack.com/zotero?ids=10.1109/access.2025.3648056) is a close lead

screening_limitations: Initial formulations, not entire research fields, were excluded.
Dataset names without an access check remain leads.
The full ESA pipeline was excluded on resource assumptions; this does not exclude every reduced telemetry study.

scoring_policy.user_request: Score the previously unscored projects first.
scoring_policy.qualification_rule: Existing gates and category rating thresholds retained; ethics/responsible use removed from weighted scoring at user request.
scoring_policy.provisional_exception: TS2-R and CV1-R scored for comparison before gate clearance at user request; unresolved gates still block qualification.
scoring_policy.team_structure: One shared problem with three independently assessable contributions; shared infrastructure allowed and papers optional.
scoring_policy.precision_note: Decimal totals reflect weighted arithmetic, not measurement precision or statistical certainty.
scoring_policy.scope: Assessment of current proposals and existing evidence; not a new discovery search or model experiment.
scoring_policy.rubric_change: Removed the 2-weight ethics/responsible-use scoring category; retained the other nine relative weights.
scoring_policy.normalisation: sum((rating / 5) * weight) / 98 * 100; round only the final total to one decimal place.
